summary: Iter 216 — Growth analytics (visit beacon, Traffic vs Conversion, Signup QR cards) + Clarity/GA4 + signup funnel events + region-aware CTAs. Backend: 10/10 pytest pass. Frontend: all CTAs route correctly (Landing intl→/signup-salon-us, in→/signup-salon-india; Restaurant INR/USD toggle; Blog + Login CTAs → dedicated pages; legacy /signup-salon still has toggles). Visit beacon fires on marketing pages with correct vid/region. Signup funnel gtag + clarity events fire (signup_start on load [observed via clarity stub], signup_step {step=2, step_name=owner, business_type=salon, region=in, locked=true}, signup_error with error=owner_name). HQ Mira Home right panel shows traffic-conversion-card with data-verdict='traffic', verdict text, tiles, GA4 + Clarity (yrwbxjqzwq) deep-links. Found and FIXED 1 critical bug: SignupQrCards referenced c.base.replace (undefined) instead of d.base.replace — crashed the entire Documents tab with ErrorBoundary 'Something went off-script'. After fix, 4 QR cards render, PNG images load (naturalWidth=492), copy/download/print controls present.

ui_bugs.issue: c.base.replace(...) — field 'base' is on root response, not per card. Threw 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading replace)' and the ErrorBoundary swallowed the entire Documents tab. FIXED by changing c.base → d.base.
